name: Save Card - UtilityDiscussion
purpose: Save action of the Discussion card: commits, sends UtilityDiscussion::AsJSON to karbon_kontroller Create Discussion v2, shows an error dialog on failure, otherwise closes the card and opens the new discussion in a window (Open Discussion in New Window { data } v2).
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/421 "Create Discussion v2" (step 5, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/313 "Open Discussion in New Window { data } v2" (step 20)
open_question: The discussion itself is created by the kontroller script 421.
